narrative.overview: The Sommelier web dashboard (bus/ui/) is an operational swarm observatory modeled on Swiss cartographic survey sheets and transit control schedules. Every swarm participant renders as a calibrated survey station with a vertical transit-line worker track, paired with precision SVG hatched quota gauges, an immediate top anomaly triage strip, and a docked live bus feed.
keyCharacteristics: Committed deep survey-indigo header shell anchoring live tabular telemetry counters and connection state.
Dual-polarity OKLCH token architecture: cool survey-paper light ground and nocturnal chart slate dark ground.
Dual-encoded worker and state semantics combining hue with distinct geometric node silhouettes.

rules.name: The Zero-Inline-Style Rule
rules.body: All color, layout, and state variations must use CSS classes, data-* attributes, or SVG geometry attributes; inline style="..." attributes are forbidden by the hub CSP.

rules.name: The Dual-Encoding Rule
rules.body: State color never works alone: running, blocked, idle, quiet, and done each carry distinct geometry and explicit text labels.

dos: Do keep all visual styling in bus/ui/style.css using classes, data-* attributes, and SVG attributes.
Do preserve bus/tests/quota_live.rs DOM/export contracts (renderPools, pool-bar-used, pool-bar-committed, pool-bar-line, pool-bar-reserve, waiting_tasks, is-greyed).
Do bump ?v= query parameters in bus/ui/index.html whenever editing style.css, app.js, or views/*.js.
donts: Don't emit inline style="..." attributes or <style> tags in HTML or JS templates.
Don't add external CDN fonts, stylesheets, or scripts.
Don't overwrite bus/DESIGN.md (which documents the Rust bus backend).
